description: Casos curados y revisados para validar automaticamente los fragmentos ejecutables de B2. El validador NUNCA ejecuta cadenas extraidas de las preguntas: solo estos casos, con clasificacion explicita y aserciones deterministas.

resultProtocol.description: Cada caso imprime en stdout una linea 'RESULT:' seguida de un objeto JSON. El validador compara ese objeto con el campo 'expect' y exige ademas el codigo de salida declarado.

cases.purpose: Componer rutas con pathlib sin concatenar separadores.
cases.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("datos") / "sub" / "f.txt"
result = {
    "parts": list(base.parts),
    "name": base.name,
    "suffix": base.suffix,
    "parent_name": base.parent.name,
    "is_absolute": base.is_absolute(),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Crear directorios dos veces con exist_ok=True sin error (idempotencia de creacion).
cases.code:
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
target = root / "out" / "sub"
target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
result = {
    "created": target.is_dir(),
    "parents_created": (root / "out").is_dir(),
    "inside_temp": str(target).startswith(str(root)),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Enumerar iterdir/rglob y leer metadatos (nombre, extension, tamano) de un fixture temporal.
cases.code:
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
(root / "sub").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / "a.txt").write_text("hola", encoding="utf-8")
(root / "sub" / "b.csv").write_text("id\n1\n", encoding="utf-8")
(root / "sub" / "c.txt").write_text("abc", encoding="utf-8")
direct = sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir())
recursive_txt = sorted(p.name for p in root.rglob("*.txt"))
result = {
    "direct_names": direct,
    "recursive_txt": recursive_txt,
    "suffix_a": (root / "a.txt").suffix,
    "size_a": (root / "a.txt").stat().st_size,
    "is_file_a": (root / "a.txt").is_file(),
    "is_dir_sub": (root / "sub").is_dir(),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: copy2 conserva el original; move y rename cambian ubicacion/nombre conservando el contenido.
cases.code:
import json, os, shutil
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
src = root / "origen.txt"
src.write_text("contenido", encoding="utf-8")
copy = root / "copia.txt"
shutil.copy2(src, copy)
moved = root / "movido.txt"
shutil.move(str(copy), str(moved))
renamed = root / "renombrado.txt"
moved.rename(renamed)
result = {
    "origin_intact": src.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "contenido",
    "copy_removed_by_move": not copy.exists(),
    "moved_removed_by_rename": not moved.exists(),
    "final_content": renamed.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Path.unlink borra solo el archivo objetivo dentro del fixture temporal; el resto permanece.
cases.code:
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
victim = root / "a_borrar.txt"
keeper = root / "conservar.txt"
victim.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
keeper.write_text("y", encoding="utf-8")
existed = victim.exists()
victim.unlink()
result = {
    "existed_before": existed,
    "victim_gone": not victim.exists(),
    "keeper_still_there": keeper.exists(),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Leer/escribir texto con encoding explicito, filtrar lineas vacias y anexar sin sobrescribir.
cases.code:
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
p = root / "nota.txt"
p.write_text("linea1\n\nlinea2\n", encoding="utf-8")
lines = [ln for ln in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if ln.strip()]
appended = root / "append.txt"
with appended.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("primera\n")
with appended.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("segunda\n")
text = appended.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
result = {
    "non_empty_lines": lines,
    "appended_text": text,
    "appended_line_count": len(text.splitlines()),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: csv.DictReader convierte cada fila en un registro accesible por encabezado y los campos llegan como texto.

text = "id,estado,importe\n1,abierto,10\n2,cerrado,20\n"

    "headers": list(rows[0].keys()),
    "field_type": type(rows[0]["importe"]).__name__,
    "first_state": rows[0]["estado"],

}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: csv.DictWriter con encoding utf-8 explicito conserva encabezados y acentos al reabrir el CSV.
cases.code:
import csv, json, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["B2_SNIPPET_TEMP"])
out = root / "salida.csv"
fieldnames = ["id", "nombre"]
with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=fieldnames)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerow({"id": "1", "nombre": "Añó"})
    writer.writerow({"id": "2", "nombre": "Peña"})
with out.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    reread = list(csv.DictReader(fh))
result = {
    "header_ok": out.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0] == "id,nombre",
    "row_count": len(reread),
    "accent_preserved": reread[0]["nombre"] == "Añó",
    "second_name": reread[1]["nombre"],
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: json.loads/json.dumps preserva tipos nativos (string, bool, int, list, null) en ida y vuelta.
cases.code:
import json

raw = '{"nombre": "informe", "activo": true, "total": 3, "items": [1, 2], "extra": null}'
data = json.loads(raw)
serialized = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
again = json.loads(serialized)
result = {
    "nombre": data["nombre"],
    "activo_type": type(data["activo"]).__name__,
    "total_type": type(data["total"]).__name__,
    "items_len": len(data["items"]),
    "extra_is_none": data["extra"] is None,
    "roundtrip_equal": again == data,
    "top_level_type": type(data).__name__,
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: re.search con grupos captura anio y mes; las anclas ^ y $ restringen la coincidencia completa.
cases.code:
import json, re

m = re.search(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})", "2026-09")
found = re.findall(r"INC-(\d{4})-(\d+)", "INC-2026-00421 y INC-2025-00007")
no_match = re.search(r"^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$", "2026-09-extra")
result = {
    "groups": list(m.groups()) if m else None,
    "found": [list(g) for g in found],
    "anchored_match_is_none": no_match is None,
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: re.sub sustituye solo los fragmentos que cumplen el patron; puede reordenar grupos capturados.
cases.code:
import json, re

reordered = re.sub(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})", r"\2/\1", "fecha 2026-09")
masked = re.sub(r"\d", "#", "a1b2")
result = {"reordered": reordered, "masked": masked}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: sorted(), set() y acumuladores convierten registros en resultados ordenados, deduplicados y agregados.
cases.code:
import json

tickets = [
    {"id": "2", "categoria": "red", "importe": 10},
    {"id": "1", "categoria": "app", "importe": 20},
    {"id": "2", "categoria": "red", "importe": 30},
]
sorted_ids = [t["id"] for t in sorted(tickets, key=lambda t: t["id"])]
unique = sorted({t["id"] for t in tickets})
group = {}
for t in tickets:
    group[t["categoria"]] = group.get(t["categoria"], 0) + t["importe"]
total = sum(t["importe"] for t in tickets)
result = {"sorted_ids": sorted_ids, "unique_ids": unique, "sum_by_category": group, "total": total}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Capturar excepciones especificas (ValueError, JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError) y limpiar en finally.
sys.exit propaga un codigo de salida no cero al proceso llamador (aqui 3).
cases.code:
import json, sys

result = {"error_previsto": "ValueError", "codigo": 3}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(3)

cases.purpose: argparse aplica el valor por defecto cuando no se indica el parametro y respeta el valor explicito.
cases.code:
import argparse, json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="herramienta B2")
parser.add_argument("--formato", default="csv", choices=["csv", "json"])
parser.add_argument("--entrada", required=False)
defaults = parser.parse_args([])
explicit = parser.parse_args(["--formato", "json"])
result = {
    "default_formato": defaults.formato,
    "explicit_formato": explicit.formato,
    "entrada": defaults.entrada,
    "prog_set": bool(parser.prog),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Guard if __name__ == "__main__" separa definiciones de la ejecucion directa (solo se valida sintaxis).
logging con nivel WARNING oculta info y conserva aviso y error, con formato controlado.
cases.code:
import io, json, logging

stream = io.StringIO()
logger = logging.getLogger("b2-snippet")
logger.handlers.clear()
logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
handler = logging.StreamHandler(stream)
handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(levelname)s:%(message)s"))
logger.addHandler(handler)
logger.info("no aparece")
logger.warning("aviso")
logger.error("fallo")
captured = stream.getvalue().strip().splitlines()
result = {
    "lines": captured,
    "info_hidden": all("no aparece" not in ln for ln in captured),
    "count": len(captured),
}
print("RESULT:" + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))

cases.purpose: Antipatron except: pass: oculta el error real. Se registra para probar que el deny-check lo rechaza; nunca se ejecuta.
Join-Path compone segmentos con el separador del sistema.
cases.code:
$sep = [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
$joined = Join-Path "datos" "sub"
$nested = Join-Path (Join-Path "datos" "sub") "f.txt"
$out = [ordered]@{
  joined = $joined
  joined_ok = ($joined -eq ("datos" + $sep + "sub"))
  nested_ok = ($nested -eq ("datos" + $sep + "sub" + $sep + "f.txt"))
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Test-Path/Get-Item/Get-ChildItem (-Recurse -Filter) y New-Item -Force sobre un fixture temporal.
cases.code:
$root = $env:B2_SNIPPET_TEMP
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $root "sub") -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "a.txt") -Value "hola" -Encoding utf8
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root (Join-Path "sub" "b.txt")) -Value "abc" -Encoding utf8
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $root "out") -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $root "out") -Force | Out-Null
$a = Join-Path $root "a.txt"
$item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $a
$out = [ordered]@{
  test_path_true = (Test-Path -LiteralPath $a)
  test_path_false = (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "missing.txt"))
  is_container = $item.PSIsContainer
  suffix = $item.Extension
  size_matches = ($item.Length -eq ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($a).Length))
  size_positive = ($item.Length -gt 0)
  direct_count = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root).Count
  recursive_txt = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Filter *.txt).Count
  idempotent_create = (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "out"))
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Copy-Item conserva el original; Rename-Item y Move-Item cambian nombre/ubicacion dentro del fixture temporal.
cases.code:
$root = $env:B2_SNIPPET_TEMP
$src = Join-Path $root "origen.txt"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $src -Value "contenido" -Encoding utf8
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $root "copia.txt")
Rename-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "copia.txt") -NewName "renombrado.txt"
Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "renombrado.txt") -Destination (Join-Path $root "destino.txt")
$out = [ordered]@{
  origin_intact = ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $src -Raw).Trim() -eq "contenido")
  copy_path_gone = -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "copia.txt"))
  renamed_path_gone = -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "renombrado.txt"))
  moved_content_ok = ((Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "destino.txt") -Raw).Trim() -eq "contenido")
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Remove-Item con -ErrorAction Stop borra solo el archivo objetivo dentro del fixture temporal.
cases.code:
$root = $env:B2_SNIPPET_TEMP
$victim = Join-Path $root "a_borrar.txt"
$keeper = Join-Path $root "conservar.txt"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $victim -Value "x" -Encoding utf8
Set-Content -LiteralPath $keeper -Value "y" -Encoding utf8

Remove-Item -LiteralPath $victim -ErrorAction Stop

cases.purpose: Set-Content/Add-Content escriben y anexan lineas; Get-Content las devuelve como coleccion.
cases.code:

$p = Join-Path $root "nota.txt"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $p -Value @("linea1", "", "linea2") -Encoding utf8
Add-Content -LiteralPath $p -Value "linea3" -Encoding utf8

cases.purpose: Import-Csv convierte cada fila en un objeto con propiedades por encabezado; los valores llegan como texto.
cases.code:
$root = $env:B2_SNIPPET_TEMP
$p = Join-Path $root "datos.csv"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $p -Value @("id,estado,importe", "1,abierto,10", "2,cerrado,20") -Encoding utf8
$rows = Import-Csv -LiteralPath $p
$out = [ordered]@{
  row_count = @($rows).Count
  first_state = $rows[0].estado
  importe_is_string = ($rows[0].importe -is [string])

Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Export-Csv con -NoTypeInformation y encoding produce un CSV que se reimporta conservando encabezados y acentos.
cases.code:
$root = $env:B2_SNIPPET_TEMP
$rows = @(
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "1"; nombre = "Añó" },
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "2"; nombre = "Peña" }
)
$p = Join-Path $root "salida.csv"
$rows | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $p -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8
$reread = Import-Csv -LiteralPath $p
$header = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1
$out = [ordered]@{
  row_count = @($reread).Count
  accent_preserved = ($reread[0].nombre -eq "Añó")
  header_kept = ($header -match "id")
  second_name_ok = ($reread[1].nombre -eq "Peña")
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: ConvertFrom-Json deserializa texto en objetos PSCustomObject preservando booleanos, numeros, arrays y null.
cases.code:
$raw = '{"nombre": "informe", "activo": true, "total": 3, "items": [1, 2], "extra": null}'
$data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$out = [ordered]@{
  nombre = $data.nombre
  activo_is_bool = ($data.activo -is [bool])
  total = $data.total
  items_len = @($data.items).Count
  extra_is_null = ($null -eq $data.extra)
  top_type = $data.GetType().Name
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: ConvertTo-Json -Depth suficiente conserva el anidamiento; una profundidad insuficiente lo trunca.
-match/$Matches extraen grupos y -replace sustituye por patron.
cases.code:
$out = [ordered]@{}
$out["match_ok"] = ("INC-2026-00421" -match "INC-(\d{4})-(\d+)")
$out["group_year"] = $Matches[1]
$out["group_code"] = $Matches[2]
$out["replaced"] = ("2026-09" -replace "(\d{4})-(\d{2})", '$2/$1')
$out["literal_preferred"] = ("INC-2026" -eq "INC-2026")
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Where-Object conserva los objetos que cumplen la condicion (la pipeline transporta objetos).
Select-Object -Property proyecta cada objeto dejando solo las propiedades indicadas.
Sort-Object -Unique ordena por la clave y conserva una sola entrada por valor.
cases.code:
$items = @(
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "2" },
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "1" },
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "2" },
  [pscustomobject]@{ id = "3" }
)
$sortedUnique = @($items | Sort-Object -Property id -Unique)
$sortedAll = @($items | Sort-Object -Property id)
$out = [ordered]@{
  unique_ids = ($sortedUnique.id -join ",")
  unique_count = $sortedUnique.Count
  all_ids = ($sortedAll.id -join ",")
  all_count = $sortedAll.Count
}
Write-Output ("RESULT:" + ($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress))

cases.purpose: Group-Object crea un grupo por cada valor distinto de la propiedad indicada.
Measure-Object -Property importe -Sum acumula el valor de la propiedad indicada.
-ErrorAction Stop hace terminante el error y permite capturarlo; sin el, catch no se ejecuta. finally siempre corre.
Write-Verbose/Warning/Error escriben en sus flujos respectivos y pueden capturarse de forma explicita.

  [string]$Entrada = "datos"
)

Write-Output ("herramienta B2 ($Formato) sobre $Entrada")

cases.purpose: Sobrescritura silenciosa sin politica de colision. Se registra para probar el deny-check; nunca se ejecuta.
cases.code: Move-Item -LiteralPath $origen -Destination $destino -Force
